summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting a cash dividend declaration on its Voting Preferred Stock. The dividend is P2,437,500 for the quarter ending July 15, 2026, payable on July 15, 2026 to holders of record as of June 23, 2026, declared from audited unrestricted retained earnings. This is a routine dividend notification, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The filing provides no deal terms, advisors, or structural changes.
